basic_details.job_title: IGIMS Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 8 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Indira Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences (IGIMS) has announced 8 vacancies for Senior Resident posts in the Department of Cardiology on a contract basis for an adhoc appointment of 89 days. Candidates possessing MS/MD Medicine and aged 45 Years as on 7 February 2026 can attend the walk-in interview on 24 October 2026, reporting at 10:00 AM. The pay is as per Institute rule. Applicants must report for the walk-in interview with the prescribed application form, requisite fee paid via Demand Draft payable to The Director, IGIMS, Patna, and copies of all supportive certificates and documents. important_instructions: Stay in campus is compulsory if accommodation is provided; if not provided, HRA's admissible as per rule. The post is non-practicing, and private practice of any kind, direct or indirect, is strictly prohibited. content_sections.heading: IGIMS Senior Resident Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The institute has notified a total of 8 vacancies for Senior Resident in the Department of Cardiology under an 89-days residency program. The category-wise distribution of vacancies is detailed below:

content_sections.heading: IGIMS Senior Resident Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 45 Years as on 07th Feb 2026. Relaxation is applicable as per State Govt. Rule, i.e., 05 Years for SC/ST, 03 Years for EBC/BC and 03 years for all categories of Female Candidate.

content_sections.heading: IGIMS Senior Resident Application Fee
content_sections.text: The cost of the application form is payable to The Director, IGIMS, Patna, in the form of a Demand Draft.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Prescribed application form downloaded from the official website. Demand Draft for the requisite application fee. Copies of all supportive certificates and documents including proof of age, qualification, reservation, and caste. Original certificates and documents for verification before the interview. No Objection Certificate issued by the employer (if employed in Government/Semi Government Department). Caste Certificate issued by Circle Officer of respective District/Circle along with Certificate of exemption from Creamy Layer (for EBC-(MBC)/BC candidates).

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process for the IGIMS Senior Resident recruitment involves document verification followed by an interview. Candidates must fulfill the minimum qualifying criteria for appointment to the post of Senior Residents, which are: UR - 50th Percentile BC/EBC/EWS - 45th Percentile SC/ST - 40th Percentile The scheme of marking for such ad-hoc appointments is based on academic qualifications (MBBS, MS/MD/DNB, additional qualifications, publications, poster/presentation, academic award, specialized training, project/extramural) and subject knowledge, totaling 100 marks.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IGIMS Senior Resident
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the official website www.igims.org. Fill out the prescribed application form with all required details. Prepare the application fee in the form of a Demand Draft payable to The Director, IGIMS, Patna. Attach copies of all supportive certificates and documents regarding age, qualification, reservation, and caste. Report for the walk-in interview on 24 October 2026 at 10:00 AM at the specified venue along with original documents.

content_sections.heading: IGIMS Senior Resident Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Stay in campus is compulsory if accommodation is provided; if not provided, HRA's admissible as per rule. The post is non-practicing, and private practice of any kind, direct or indirect, is strictly prohibited. Candidates employed in Government or Semi Government departments must submit a "No Objection Certificate" from their employer at the time of interview. Reservation and relaxation benefits are applicable only to Bihar State Domicile candidates. The Director of the Institute reserves the right to reject or accept any or all applications without assigning any reason. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is the walk-in date for IGIMS Senior Resident Cardiology recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 24 October 2026, with reporting time at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. What is the venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at the HOD. Cardiology Chamber, (Poly wing Clinic 3rd floor), IGIMS, Patna-14.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for IGIMS Senior Resident Cardiology?
faq.answer: A total of 8 vacancies are available in the Department of Cardiology.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MS/MD Medicine degree.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 45 years as on 7 February 2026, with relaxations applicable as per State Government rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for UR and EWS candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 1000/- for UR/EWS/BC/EBC candidates and Rs. 250/- for SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q7. Is the appointment permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The appointment is an ad-hoc appointment for 89 days in the Department of Cardiology.

faq.question: Q8. Who is eligible for reservation benefits?
faq.answer: Reservation benefits and age relaxations are applicable solely to Bihar State Domicile candidates.
